title: Customer changes mind after restaurant acceptance
facts_text: I placed and paid for my order. The restaurant accepted it and has started preparing it. I have changed my mind and would like to cancel.
request: Please cancel the order and refund the full amount, including delivery and service fees.

strict.reason: The customer requested a change-of-mind cancellation after restaurant acceptance and preparation began.
